company.name: Chipax
company.shortDescription: We make SMB accounting simpler, with real-time data collection from IRS and banks, automated reporting (cash flow, income statement, etc)
company.description: A Fintech making SMB accounting dramatically simpler, with real-time data collection from IRS and banks, and automated reporting on what’s most important (cash flow, income statement, debts payable, etc.) We make the day-to-day easier, through tools such as bank reconciliation, cash flow forecasting, or debt collection tools.

productsAndServices.description: Automatically collects and organizes financial data from tax authorities, banks, and company software to provide accurate and up-to-date financial information.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Data Integration

productsAndServices.description: Automates the matching of bank transactions with company records using customizable rules and supports payment gateway reconciliations.
productsAndServices.name: Bank Reconciliation

productsAndServices.description: Manages customer collections by marking invoices as paid, sending collection emails, and tracking outstanding payments.
productsAndServices.name: Accounts Receivable Management (Cobranza)

productsAndServices.description: Generates customizable financial reports and dashboards including income statements, cash flow projections, and operational results.
productsAndServices.name: Financial Reporting and Dashboards

productsAndServices.description: Allows businesses to create and manage a structured chart of accounts to organize financial transactions and reporting.
productsAndServices.name: Chart of Accounts Management (Plan de Cuentas)

productsAndServices.description: Supports reconciliation of transactions from payment gateways like Transbank, GetNet, and Mercado Pago within the bank reconciliation process.
productsAndServices.name: Payment Gateway Reconciliation

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $575,000, or 65.71% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,514,021 to $6,985,456, a 2.78x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 63 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 41 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Contabilium, Defontana, Alegra.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
